tool_args.rationale: The high-gradient probe reveals a sharp supercritical decline, matching the recalled avalanche law. Fit its parameters numerically and test it on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane substrate inhibition and Cobb–Douglas production
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The high-gradient observations show a steep decline to negative values, consistent with a threshold avalanche rather than either positive-valued alternative.
The eight observations now cover both sides of the threshold and constrain the five-parameter mechanism; another probe is not needed before confirmation.
It does not discriminate the proposed mechanism.
